roles.label: SOC Analyst (L1 / Fresher)
roles.description: Monitors alerts, triages incidents, and works SIEM dashboards — the most common first job in cybersecurity.

roles.label: VAPT / Associate Security Analyst
roles.description: Vulnerability assessment and penetration testing track — finds, verifies, and reports security weaknesses.

roles.label: Network Security Engineer (entry-level)
roles.description: Configures and defends network infrastructure — firewalls, routing, and network protocols.

roles.label: Cybersecurity Intern / Generalist
roles.description: Not sure yet, or want the broadest view — the default track if you don't pick one.
